edits.before: For another PAYE job, we assume it uses your National Insurance threshold. Your actual payroll may differ.
edits.after: In the suggested pay options, selecting other PAYE employment means we estimate employee National Insurance from the first pound of director salary. Jobs with separate employers usually have separate thresholds, so this may overstate your NI. Check with your payroll provider.

edits.before: Pension tax limits may restrict the relief available on company contributions.
edits.after: Company pension contributions count towards your annual allowance across all your pensions. Going over your available allowance may mean a personal tax charge, which is not included in this estimate. Unused allowance from the previous three tax years may help; high income or some pension withdrawals can reduce your allowance.
